title: A Flood in Riverton
text:
Yesterday, heavy rain fell on the small town of Riverton. The river rose quickly, and many roads were closed. The local police told people to stay at home until the water went down.

Some families had to leave their houses. The town hall opened a school as a shelter, and about fifty people slept there last night. Officials said the rain would stop tomorrow, and the roads should open soon.

questions.text: What did the town hall open as a shelter?
Why did the police tell people to stay at home?
What can the reader infer about the roads in Riverton?
options: They will stay closed for a long time
They are too narrow for cars

vocabulary.definition: went up to a higher level
a place that protects people from danger or bad weather
people who hold an official job or position

paragraph_translations: Dün Riverton adlı küçük kasabaya şiddetli yağmur yağdı. Nehir hızla yükseldi ve birçok yol kapandı. Yerel polis, su çekilene kadar insanlara evde kalmalarını söyledi.

Bazı aileler evlerini terk etmek zorunda kaldı. Belediye binası bir okulu barınak olarak açtı ve dün gece yaklaşık elli kişi orada uyudu. Yetkililer yağmurun yarın duracağını ve yolların kısa sürede açılması gerektiğini söyledi.
